Custom policies: labels, own hits or recent outcomes
Static label tiers + shared tier; recency/8s hold vs FIFO/no expiry.
Protect after the block’s own first hit; labels not required.
100 resolved outcomes/label; full window ≥5% hits admits new blocks.
Lower tiers first; protected unused blocks remain evictable.
Labels come from datasets, not an online classifier. RFIFO does not retroactively promote an existing low block.
